bukhari:891.grader: Sahih al-Bukhari (compiler's criteria; sunnah.com shows no separate grade)
bukhari:891.note: Abu Huraira: the best day on which the sun has risen is Friday; on it Adam was created, admitted to Paradise and expelled from it, and the Hour comes only on Friday. Used in the Jumu'ah modern-hadith card.

muslim:233.grader: Sahih Muslim (compiler's criteria; sunnah.com shows no separate grade)
muslim:233.note: Abu Huraira: the five prayers and Friday to Friday expiate what is between them so long as the major sins are avoided. Used in the Jumu'ah modern-hadith card.

ibnmajah:2341.note: Ibn Abbas: no harming and no reciprocating of harm; the basis of the When It Is Not Safe card in the Sakina marriage room.
